## Highlights
### New
- You can turn off the animation from the address field into the command palette in Look and Feel, so the palette opens right away.
### Improved
- Folder symbols take the folder color when tinted folder titles are turned on.
### Fixed
- Feature Flags in Settings shows WebKit's flags when WebKit is your default engine, instead of an empty page.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
